newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Newton Investment Mgt opens Hong Kong office.
newsitem.headline: Newton Investment Mgt opens Hong Kong office.

text.p: London-based fund manager Newton Investment Management Ltd said on Tuesday it had opened an office in Hong Kong and launched its international growth fund in the territory.

The Hong Kong office will be staffed by Connie Fung, who will be responsible for helping Newton contact Chinese investors it knows in the region and for marketing products and services to local banks, investors and financial advisers, it said.
Newton Universal Growth Funds (NUGF), recognised by regulatory authorities in Britain and Hong Kong, was an umbrella fund encompassing 15 individual sub-funds, it said.
